title: Among female patients aged 50 or older with abnormal red blood cell counts,
question: Among female patients aged 50 or older with abnormal red blood cell counts, return their ID, admission status, and whether their uric acid level from their most recent laboratory test is within the normal range for females. Only include patients diagnosed with a condition that also appears in patients who have elevated ALT (GPT > 60).

prediction.sql:
WITH RecentLabs AS (
    SELECT
        L.XCL_014 AS pid,
        L.XCL_022 AS uric_acid,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY L.XCL_014 ORDER BY L.XCL_015 DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory L
),
ElevatedAltConditions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT E.XCL_008 AS condition
    FROM Examination E
    INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON E.XCL_001 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE L.XCL_016 > 60
)
SELECT
    P.XCL_058 AS ID,
    E.XCL_006 AS admission_status,
    CASE WHEN RL.uric_acid BETWEEN 2.5 AND 6.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS uric_acid_normal
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.XCL_058 = E.XCL_001
INNER JOIN RecentLabs RL ON P.XCL_058 = RL.pid AND RL.rn = 1
WHERE
    P.XCL_059 = 'F'
    AND P.XCL_060 <= date('now', '-50 years')
    AND (E.XCL_003 < 3.5 OR E.XCL_003 > 5.5)
    AND E.XCL_008 IN (SELECT condition FROM ElevatedAltConditions)

WITH RecentLabs AS (
    SELECT
        L.XCL_014 AS pid,
        L.XCL_022 AS uric_acid,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY L.XCL_014 ORDER BY L.XCL_015 DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory L
),
ElevatedAltConditions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT E.XCL_008 AS condition
    FROM Examination E
    INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON E.XCL_001 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE L.XCL_016 > 60
)
SELECT
    P.XCL_058 AS ID,
    E.XCL_006 AS admission_status,
    CASE WHEN RL.uric_acid BETWEEN 2.5 AND 6.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS uric_acid_normal
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.XCL_058 = E.XCL_001
INNER JOIN RecentLabs RL ON P.XCL_058 = RL.pid AND RL.rn = 1
WHERE
    P.XCL_059 = 'F'
    AND P.XCL_060 <= date('now', '-50 years')
    AND (E.XCL_003 < 3.5 OR E.XCL_003 > 5.5)
    AND E.XCL_008 IN (SELECT condition FROM ElevatedAltConditions)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH RecentLabs AS (
    SELECT
        L.XCL_014 AS pid,
        L.XCL_022 AS uric_acid,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY L.XCL_014 ORDER BY L.XCL_015 DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory L
),
ElevatedAltConditions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT E.XCL_008 AS condition
    FROM Examination E
    INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON E.XCL_001 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE L.XCL_016 > 60
)
SELECT
    P.XCL_058 AS ID,
    E.XCL_006 AS admission_status,
    CASE WHEN RL.uric_acid BETWEEN 2.5 AND 6.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS uric_acid_normal
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.XCL_058 = E.XCL_001
INNER JOIN RecentLabs RL ON P.XCL_058 = RL.pid AND RL.rn = 1
WHERE
    P.XCL_059 = 'F'
    AND P.XCL_060 <= date('now', '-50 years')
    AND (E.XCL_003 < 3.5 OR E.XCL_003 > 5.5)
    AND E.XCL_008 IN (SELECT condition FROM ElevatedAltConditions)

    p.XCL_058 AS patient_id,
    e.XCL_006 AS admission_status,
    CASE
        WHEN l.XCL_035 BETWEEN 2.7 AND 7.0 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS uric_acid_normal
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.XCL_058 = e.XCL_001
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE
    p.XCL_063 = 'F'
    AND (
        (p.XCL_060 IS NOT NULL AND (julianday('now') - julianday(p.XCL_060)) / 365.25 >= 50)
        OR
        (p.XCL_061 IS NOT NULL AND (julianday('now') - julianday(p.XCL_061)) / 365.25 >= 50)
    )
    AND e.XCL_005 NOT BETWEEN 4000000 AND 5400000
    AND l.XCL_015 = (
        SELECT MAX(l2.XCL_015)
        FROM Laboratory l2
        WHERE l2.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
    )
    AND p.XCL_058 IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT p2.XCL_058
        FROM Patient p2
        JOIN Examination e2 ON p2.XCL_058 = e2.XCL_001
        JOIN Laboratory l3 ON p2.XCL_058 = l3.XCL_014
        WHERE l3.XCL_030 > 60
    )
